Where English now says 'the Hangyul team', 你的顧問/合作代辦 replaced with Hangyul 團隊; keys whose English still says 'your counselor' keep 你的顧問 (owner: English is inconsistent across visaroute/concierge/success).
Em-dashes removed where English switched to sentences; Chinese uses ，/。 instead.

Terms: personal statement 自傳, study plan 讀書計畫, apostille 海牙認證, 사업자등록증 = 營業登記證明.
